headline: Azerbaijan Revises Forecasts of State Budget Revenues and Expenditures for Next Year
summary: Forecasts of Azerbaijan's state budget revenues and expenditures for 2027 have been significantly revised compared with estimates in earlier budget packages.
why: State budget revenue and spending forecasts shape fiscal deficits and borrowing needs, which matter for sovereign debt investors.
